// CASE dart_dup_plain expect=fire
Future<void> inOrder<T>(Iterable<T> items, Future<void> Function(T item) step, {required String reason}) async {
  for (final item in items) {
    pair(await step(item), await step(item));
  }
}
// CASE dart_dup_two_strings expect=fire
Future<void> inOrder<T>(Iterable<T> items, Future<void> Function(T item) step, {required String reason}) async {
  for (final item in items) {
    pair(await step(item), 'a', await step(item), 'b');
  }
}
